purpose: Running tracker of sportsbook promotions, rewards and bonus cash that change how tickets should be built or funded. Check the 'active' items at every card build. Reward cash is logged here first, then as funding on the ticket it is applied to.

how_promo_type_changes_the_build.cash_no_strings: Same as your own money: stake comes back on a win. Just shop the best price.
how_promo_type_changes_the_build.free_bet_credit: Stake is NOT returned on a win, so the credit is worth more on longer prices. Use on +300 or longer where possible.
how_promo_type_changes_the_build.parlay_insurance_cash_refund: The losing outcome is refunded, so build the longest, highest-payout ticket that still qualifies, up to the max insured stake. Don't spend the insured slot on a safe chalk ticket.

items.name: Super Bowl Futures Special - $10 free bet per Bills regular-season win
items.credit_timing: By 7:00 pm ET the Wednesday after each Bills win

expected_credits.plan: Cover the $9.09 BUF SB cash boost (bet_20260917_996987591, +950): any price -110 or better returns >= $9.09 profit

items.use: Free roll on a side/total at -110. Each winner pays $9.09.
items.strategy: Put each credit on the week's highest-conviction side or total as soon as it lands (Wednesday), shopping the best number around key numbers 3/7. Avoid spread underdogs (10-20 season). First winner clears the $9.09 BUF SB boost (bet_20260917_996987591); later winners go to the BUF futures bankroll. Expect ~5 winners from ~10 credits (~$45). Hedging via the Bills opponent spread is optional, only when it is also the best read.
items.restrictions: Credit usable ONLY on sides or totals at about -110 (Andy, 2026-09-21). Stake not returned; a win pays $9.09.
